integrity: All new proofs are supplied; bounded exhaustive checks are distinguished from general proofs; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite reflexive linear frames with full powerset Boolean modal algebras are covered.
Random generating subsets are independent and uniform; the Poisson window requires a scaling limit.
An older highly relevant primary article on closure algebras was inaccessible in full text; novelty assessment is limited to inspected evidence.
title: Convex subalgebras and random generation of finite S4-chain algebras
